elements.name: configureUserId
elements.brief: Sets a custom user id and initializes the SDK with it. Takes effect only
elements.description:
Sets a custom user id and initializes the SDK with it. Takes effect only
when `gameanalytics.use_custom_id` is `1` in `game.project`; otherwise it
logs a warning and does nothing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.doc: The user id; an empty string raises an error.

elements.name: initialize
elements.brief: Initializes the SDK. Takes effect only when
elements.description:
Initializes the SDK. Takes effect only when
`gameanalytics.manual_initialize` is `1` in `game.project`; otherwise it
logs a warning and does nothing.

elements.name: addBusinessEvent
elements.brief: Sends a business (real-money purchase) event.
elements.description: Sends a business (real-money purchase) event.

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc:
The event. `currency`, `itemType` and `itemId` must be
non-empty strings.
types: { currency: string; amount?: number; itemType: string; itemId: string; cartType?: string; receipt?: string; signature?: string; autoFetchReceipt?: boolean; customFields?: string; mergeFields?: boolean; }

fields.name: currency
fields.doc: Currency code, such as `"USD"`.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Amount in the currency's smallest unit, truncated to an integer. Defaults to `0`.

fields.name: receipt
fields.doc: Store receipt. Accepted on iOS and Android only; elsewhere the key raises an error.

fields.name: signature
fields.doc: Receipt signature. Accepted on Android only; elsewhere the key raises an error.

fields.name: autoFetchReceipt
fields.doc:
Fetch the App Store receipt automatically instead of sending `receipt`.
Accepted on iOS only; elsewhere the key raises an error.

fields.name: customFields
fields.doc: Custom fields for this event, as a JSON object string.

fields.name: mergeFields
fields.doc: Merge `customFields` into the global custom fields instead of replacing them.

elements.name: addResourceEvent
elements.brief: Sends a resource (virtual currency) event.
elements.description: Sends a resource (virtual currency) event.

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc:
The event. `currency`, `itemType` and `itemId` must be
non-empty strings and `amount` must be greater than zero.
types: { flowType?: "Source" | "Sink"; currency: string; amount: number; itemType: string; itemId: string; customFields?: string; mergeFields?: boolean; }

fields.name: flowType
fields.doc: Whether the currency was gained (`"Source"`) or spent (`"Sink"`).

fields.name: customFields
fields.doc: Custom fields for this event, as a JSON object string.

fields.name: mergeFields
fields.doc:
Accepted as a boolean, but the extension reads it as a string, so it is
always `false` and `customFields` replaces the global custom fields.

elements.name: addProgressionEvent
elements.brief: Sends a progression event.
elements.description: Sends a progression event.

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: The event. `progression01` must be a non-empty string.
types: { progressionStatus?: "Start" | "Complete" | "Fail"; progression01: string; progression02?: string; progression03?: string; score?: number; customFields?: string; mergeFields?: boolean; }

fields.name: score
fields.doc: Score, truncated to an integer. Sent only when given.

fields.name: customFields
fields.doc: Custom fields for this event, as a JSON object string.

fields.name: mergeFields
fields.doc: Merge `customFields` into the global custom fields instead of replacing them.

elements.name: addDesignEvent
elements.brief: Sends a design event.
elements.description: Sends a design event.

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: The event. `eventId` must be a non-empty string.
types: { eventId: string; value?: number; customFields?: string; mergeFields?: boolean; }

fields.name: eventId
fields.doc: Event id, in colon-separated parts such as `"kill:sword"`.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Value sent with the event, only when given.

fields.name: customFields
fields.doc: Custom fields for this event, as a JSON object string.

fields.name: mergeFields
fields.doc: Merge `customFields` into the global custom fields instead of replacing them.

fields.name: customFields

fields.name: mergeFields

elements.name: addAdEvent
elements.brief: Sends an ad event. With `duration` the event carries the duration;
elements.description:
Sends an ad event. With `duration` the event carries the duration;
without it, the event carries `noAdReason`.

parameters.name: options
types: { adAction?: "Clicked" | "Show" | "FailedShow" | "RewardReceived"; adType?: "Video" | "RewardedVideo" | "Playable" | "Interstitial" | "OfferWall" | "Banner"; adSdkName?: string; adPlacement?: string; duration?: number; noAdReason?: "Unknown" | "Offline" | "NoFill" | "InternalError" | "InvalidRequest" | "UnableToPrecache"; customFields?: string; mergeFields?: boolean; }

fields.name: duration
fields.doc: How long the ad was shown, truncated to an integer.

fields.name: noAdReason
fields.doc: Why no ad was shown. Ignored when `duration` is given.

fields.name: customFields
fields.doc: Custom fields for this event, as a JSON object string.

fields.name: mergeFields
fields.doc: Merge `customFields` into the global custom fields instead of replacing them.
